blocks.text: Welcome to [A:https://www.lontylegames.com/]https://www.lontylegames.com/[/A] (the “Website”). At Lontyle Games, we value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your data when you visit our Website.
We may collect personal information that you voluntarily provide to us when you use our Website. This may include, but is not limited to:
We also collect non-personal information automatically when you visit our Website. This may include:
Pages you view on our Website
Dates and times of your visits
We use the information we collect for the following purposes:
To provide and maintain our Website
To improve and optimize our Website
To respond to your requests or inquiries
To send you promotional information, newsletters, or updates (only with your explicit consent)
To detect and prevent fraud and abuse

We may use cookies and similar tracking technologies to collect and store information. You can configure your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent. However, if you do not accept cookies, you may not be able to use some portions of our Website.

Our Website uses Google AdSense, a third-party advertising service provided by Google Inc. Google AdSense may use cookies to serve personalized ads based on your interests. For more information about how Google AdSense collects and processes data, please refer to Google’s [A:https://policies.google.com/privacy]Privacy Policy[/A].
We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. However, we may share your information with:
Service providers who help us operate the Website or provide services to you
Law enforcement or government authorities when required by law

We take reasonable measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is entirely secure, and we cannot guarantee its absolute security.
You can manage your personal information and communication preferences by contacting us at [A:mailto:lontyle@gmail.com]lontyle@gmail.com[/A].
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time, and the most current version will be posted on this page. We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically for any changes.
Sign up for our e-mail newsletter and stay informed for what’s next on the horizon.
We specialize in crafting innovative and futuristic Android and iOS apps, as well as engaging games, ensuring a seamless user experience and captivating narratives for the gaming projects.
